summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of mutable Field.__hash__ by reverting part of the change introduced in #31750. It maintains immutability while ensuring objects with the same hash are still checked for equality.

issues.description: Reverting part of a previous change may introduce behavioral regressions or unexpected interactions with other parts of the codebase.
The patch introduces a style inconsistency by removing parentheses around a single-element tuple in the hash function.
